title: sporobolus drummondii
intro: Sporobolus drummondii, commonly known as Drummond's grass, is a type of perennial grass native to North America. It has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, which include reducing inflammation and relieving respiratory issues such as bronchitis and asthma due to its health benefits. The plant is known to exhibit therapeutic actions such as antioxidant and anti-inflammatory properties, which are attributed to its bioactive constituents, including flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids. However, more research is needed to confirm its full range of therapeutic actions and bioactive constituents.
